tagline: Mail servers asli bank aur nakli bank mein farak kaise karte hain.
description: SMTP mein koi bhi kisi bhi sender address ka claim kar sakta hai. SPF batata hai ki kaun se servers ek domain ke liye mail bhej sakte hain, DKIM ek signature jodta hai jo DNS mein published key se check hota hai, aur DMARC dono ko us From address se jodta hai jo log asal mein dekhte hain aur receivers ko batata hai ki checks fail hone par kya karna hai.

normal.name: Asli bank ka email saare checks pass karta hai
normal.summary: MX bank.example se statement alert ke liye SPF, DKIM aur DMARC check karta hai aur ise accept kar leta hai.

steps.title: Bank connect karta hai
steps.detail: Bank ka server mail.bank.example (198.51.100.80) statement alert deliver karne ke liye Danish ke provider se connect hota hai. Receiving MX connecting IP address turant note kar leta hai: ye ek cheez hai jo sender TCP connection par fake nahi kar sakta, aur SPF isi ko check karega.
facts: SPF ye IP use karta hai

steps.title: SPF: kya ye IP allowed hai?
steps.detail: Envelope mein MAIL FROM:<bounces@bank.example> hai. Jawab dene se pehle MX bank.example ka TXT record fetch karta hai aur SPF policy "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.80/31 include:_spf.mailer.example -all" paata hai. Connecting IP 198.51.100.80, 198.51.100.80/31 ke andar hai, isliye SPF pass hota hai. Aakhir ka -all ka matlab baaki har IP fail hona chahiye.

quiz.q: SPF record -all par khatam hota hai. List mein na hone wale IP ke mail ka kya hoga?
quiz.why: -all ka matlab "baaki sab fail". ~all soft fail hota, ?all neutral.

steps.title: Signed message
steps.desc: DKIM-Signature header mail ke saath jaata hai
steps.detail: Bank ke server ne bhejne se pehle message sign kiya. DKIM-Signature header batata hai ki kisne sign kiya (d=bank.example), kaun si key use karni hai (s=mail2026), kaun se headers covered hain (h=from:to:subject:…), body ka hash (bh=) aur khud RSA signature (b=). Ek bhi covered byte badlo to check fail ho jata hai.
facts: From, To, Subject, Date, Message-ID + body

quiz.q: d=bank.example, s=mail2026 ki public key MX ko kahan milegi?
options: Bank ki website se HTTPS par
quiz.why: DKIM keys DNS mein <selector>._domainkey.<domain> par rehti hain. Selectors se domain keys rotate kar sakta hai ya kai senders use kar sakta hai.

steps.title: DKIM: key fetch karo
steps.detail: MX public key lookup karta hai aur Base64 mein 2048-bit RSA key paata hai. Wo body ko hash karke bh= se compare karta hai, phir listed headers par signature b= check karta hai. Dono match karte hain, isliye bank.example ke liye DKIM pass hota hai. Key record 255 bytes se lamba hai, isliye DNS use do strings mein store karta hai jo jod di jaati hain.

steps.title: DMARC: ise From se jodo
steps.detail: SPF aur DKIM envelope aur signer ke baare mein cheezein prove karte hain, par reader sirf From header dekhta hai. DMARC poochta hai: kya SPF ya DKIM From wale domain ke liye hi pass hua? Yahan From bank.example hai, DKIM d= bank.example hai aur SPF bank.example hai, isliye dono align hain. Policy p=reject receivers ko batati hai ki ye check fail hone par kya karna hai.

quiz.q: DMARC tab pass hota hai jab SPF ya DKIM mein se kam se kam ek pass ho aur…
options: message mein koi links na hon
uska domain From header ke domain se match kare
quiz.why: Isse alignment kehte hain. Kisi unrelated domain ka pass count nahi hota; use wahi match karna padta hai jo reader From mein dekhta hai.

steps.title: Accept karo aur label lagao
steps.detail: Teeno checks pass hue, isliye MX message ko 250 ke saath accept karta hai aur ek header jodta hai jo record karta hai ki use kya mila: Authentication-Results: mx.mailhost.example; spf=pass smtp.mailfrom=bank.example; dkim=pass header.d=bank.example header.s=mail2026; dmarc=pass (p=REJECT) header.from=bank.example. Danish ki mail app verified badge dikha sakti hai. Bank ko apne rua address par daily aggregate reports bhi milti hain, jisme dikhta hai ki uske naam se kaun mail bhej raha hai.

outro.title: Verified aur delivered
outro.text: Connecting IP bank ki SPF list mein thi, DKIM signature DNS ki key se match hua, aur dono From domain se align the, isliye DMARC pass hua. MX ne ye sab Authentication-Results header mein record kiya.

spoof.name: Bank bankar phishing email
spoof.summary: Forged bank email SPF fail karta hai, DKIM nahi hai, aur bank ka DMARC p=reject use block kar deta hai.

steps.title: Nakli bank email
steps.desc: Phisher bank.example hone ka claim karta hai
steps.detail: Ek phisher 192.0.2.66 par server kiraye par leta hai aur Danish ke MX se connect hota hai. SMTP koi bhi address MAIL FROM aur From header mein likhne deta hai, isliye wo dono mein security@bank.example claim karta hai. Checks ke bina ye bilkul asli bank jaisa dikhta.

steps.title: SPF fail
steps.desc: 192.0.2.66 bank ki list mein nahi hai
steps.detail: MX phir bank.example ka SPF record fetch karta hai. 192.0.2.66 na ip4:198.51.100.80/31 mein hai, na included mailer list mein, isliye -all rule lagta hai: spf=fail. MX abhi reject nahi karta; wo DMARC ko decide karne deta hai, aur message text accept karta hai taaki DKIM bhi check kar sake.

quiz.q: Agar phisher MAIL FROM:<x@phish.example.net> (apna domain) use karta to kya SPF pass hota?
options: Haan, SPF sirf envelope domain check karta hai, jo uske control mein hai
quiz.why: Yahi gap DMARC band karta hai: SPF phish.example.net ke liye pass hota, par wo domain From header se match nahi karta, isliye DMARC phir bhi fail hota.

steps.title: DKIM nahi, DMARC kehta hai reject
steps.desc: bank.example ke saath kuch aligned nahi
steps.detail: Message mein koi DKIM-Signature hai hi nahi (phisher ke paas bank ki private key nahi hai, isliye koi bhi nakli signature fail hi hota). SPF fail aur DKIM missing hone se bank.example ke liye kuch pass nahi hota. MX _dmarc.bank.example lookup karta hai aur p=reject paata hai.

quiz.q: SPF fail hua aur DKIM signature nahi hai. Policy p=reject hai. MX ko kya karna chahiye?
options: SMTP session ke dauran refuse kar de
quiz.why: p=reject receivers se kehta hai ki failing mail seedha refuse karo. p=quarantine ka matlab spam folder; p=none sirf report karta hai.

steps.title: 550 rejected
steps.desc: Phish Danish tak kabhi nahi pahunchta
steps.detail: MX DATA ke end par 550 5.7.1 rejection se jawab deta hai. Kyunki usne session ke dauran hi message refuse kiya, kuch store nahi hota aur forged address par bounce nahi bheja jaata. Failed attempt bank ki agli DMARC aggregate report mein dikhta hai, isliye bank ko pata chalta hai ki koi uska naam spoof kar raha hai.

outro.title: Spoof block ho gaya
outro.text: Phisher message mein kahin bhi bank.example likh sakta tha, par bank ke IPs se bhej nahi sakta tha aur bank ki private key se sign nahi kar sakta tha. DMARC ko koi aligned pass nahi mila aur bank ki p=reject policy ne use 550 bana diya.
facts: SPF publish karo, DKIM se sign karo, DMARC ko p=reject par le jao

cheatsheet.title: Har ek kya check karta hai
items: Connecting IP vs envelope MAIL FROM domain
Headers + body par signature, domain d=
SPF ya DKIM pass, From ke saath aligned

cheatsheet.title: Results aur policies
items: Daily aggregate reports kahan bhejni hain
